investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (300 files) was observed from user globalcorp@globalcorp.ee, exceeding the 24-hour baseline of zero. Downloads targeted sensitive documents (e.g., Online_Orders_Registry_2026.xlsx, Wholesale_Contact_List.xlsx, Daily_Inventory_Update.csv) from the SharePoint site https://globalcorp.sharepoint.com/, executed via an automated Python aiohttp client with the ChatGPT application. Although the activity originates from Tallinn, Estonia, during local business hours, the combination of high-volume automated access to restricted data elevates risk of data exfiltration or insider misuse, supporting a High Priority assessment.
